exposure: children conceived by assisted reproduction technologies
maternal cold, flu or virus during pregnancy
maternal gestational diabetes, toxemia, high blood pressure or pre-eclampsia during pregnancy
maternal stress or mental disorders during pregnancy
cohort: 42,551 children age 18 to 30 months in Vietnam
finding: Nine ante-, peri-, and neonatal factors were associated with ASDs in Vietnamese children aged 18 to 30 months.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was associated with ASDs.
